conditions: The Hunter has a 1.5% chance to spawn in the first 5 minutes, plus 0.5% per marked squad member. A failed roll doesn't spend the mark.
Each kill drops one item: a part, the Blueprint or the Scimitar Avionics Blueprint (17.65%, useless here), so duplicates happen.
A beacon is consumed on use, one per mission, and does nothing in Invasion missions.
No assassins in Assassination, Syndicate, Arena, Sortie, Archimedea, Landscape, Archwing, Empyrean or Sanctuary Onslaught missions, and beacons can't override that.
Being captured sends you to a Recovery mission to retrieve your gear.
bonuses: Marked squadmates raise the spawn chance.

disclosures.title: making the fight safe
disclosures.body: Trinity's Energy Vampire stun-locks the Hunter and Ivara's Sleep Arrows work, but Prowl doesn't. A knockdown such as Nekros Soul Punch or a big melee slam lets you chain knockdowns. It is immune to hard crowd control like Mag Pull or Radial Blind.
